overview.answer: Rite Cleaners and Don Royal provide professional care for everyday clothing, business wear, special garments and household textiles. Services combine cleaning, pressing, finishing, alterations and repairs.
Dry cleaning; laundry and pressed shirts; alterations and repairs; comforters and household fabrics; area rugs; leather and suede care; wedding gown cleaning and preservation.
Both brands advertise PERC-free cleaning. Rite also identifies professional wet cleaning and SystemK4 dry cleaning, with pressing, hand finishing and inspection.
Family-owned since 1968, serving Northeast Ohio. Stores are in Shaker Heights, Highland Heights, Solon, Parma, Broadview Heights and Warren.

Serves Fox Chapel and nearby Pittsburgh communities, including O’Hara, Aspinwall and Sharpsburg, from its Freeport Road storefront. Customers can bring garments to the counter for cleaning, laundry or alterations.
Rite offers 24/7 kiosk access at selected locations. Kiosk access, staffed hours and tailor hours are separate schedules. See the Store Directory for each store's hours.
Both brands offer alterations and repairs. Rite has alterations partners at Solon and Highland Heights.
Rite offers complimentary pickup and delivery for eligible Northeast Ohio addresses.
Rite advertises complimentary recleaning when a customer is not satisfied. Special requests, stains, repairs and deadlines should be discussed with the store.
Rite: 330-399-2235; info@rite-drycleaners.com. Don Royal: 412-781-9839; info@donroyalcleaners.com. Individual store phone numbers are listed in the Store Directory.

kiosk.question: How does the 24/7 kiosk work?
kiosk.answer: Four steps: 1) Register on the kiosk screen the first time. 2) Drop off your clothes in a numbered bag. 3) Get a text and email when your order is ready. 4) Come back any time, enter your phone number, pay at the kiosk, and the kiosk brings out your clothes.
kiosk.appliesTo: Shaker Heights, Highland Heights, Solon, Parma, Broadview Heights

kiosk.question: I'm at the kiosk and not sure where to start.
kiosk.answer: On the screen, tap New Customer if this is your first time, or Existing Customer if you've used it before. Then tap Drop Off Clothes or Pick Up Clothes.
kiosk.appliesTo: Shaker Heights, Highland Heights, Solon, Parma, Broadview Heights
kiosk.action: Answer one step at a time

kiosk.question: Which stores have a 24/7 kiosk?
kiosk.answer: Shaker Heights, Highland Heights, Solon, Parma and Broadview Heights have 24/7 kiosks. Warren and Don Royal do not have a kiosk.
kiosk.appliesTo: All stores

kiosk.question: Can I use the kiosk any time?
kiosk.answer: Yes. The kiosk is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year, including holidays, for drop-off and pickup.
kiosk.appliesTo: Shaker Heights, Highland Heights, Solon, Parma, Broadview Heights

kiosk.question: Is someone at the store to help me?
kiosk.answer: It depends on the store. Shaker Heights is fully unattended. The other kiosk stores have staff on-site during their staffed hours.
kiosk.appliesTo: Shaker Heights, Highland Heights, Solon, Parma, Broadview Heights
kiosk.action: Answer, then give that store's staffed hours from the Store Directory

kiosk.question: Can I drop off after hours at Warren or Don Royal?
kiosk.answer: No. Warren and Don Royal don't have a kiosk or a drop box, so please drop off during store hours.
kiosk.appliesTo: Warren, Don Royal

kiosk.question: Do I need an account to use the kiosk?
kiosk.answer: Yes. The first time, you register right on the kiosk screen. It only takes a minute.
kiosk.appliesTo: Shaker Heights, Highland Heights, Solon, Parma, Broadview Heights

kiosk.question: How do I sign up at the kiosk?
kiosk.answer: On the kiosk screen, tap New Customer. Enter your phone number, first name, last name and email using the on-screen keyboard.
kiosk.appliesTo: Shaker Heights, Highland Heights, Solon, Parma, Broadview Heights
kiosk.action: Answer one step at a time

kiosk.question: Can I sign up online instead?
kiosk.answer: Yes. You can also create an account with the Get Started button at rite-drycleaners.com.
kiosk.appliesTo: Shaker Heights, Highland Heights, Solon, Parma, Broadview Heights

kiosk.question: Do I need a PIN?
kiosk.answer: No. The kiosk does not use a PIN.
kiosk.appliesTo: Shaker Heights, Highland Heights, Solon, Parma, Broadview Heights

kiosk.question: How do I sign in at the kiosk?
kiosk.answer: Tap Existing Customer and enter the phone number you registered with.
kiosk.appliesTo: Shaker Heights, Highland Heights, Solon, Parma, Broadview Heights

kiosk.question: How do I drop off my clothes at the kiosk?
kiosk.answer: 1) On the kiosk screen, tap Existing Customer and enter your phone number. 2) Tap Drop Off Clothes. 3) Take a numbered bag from under the drop-off kiosk and put your clothes in it. 4) Add any notes, like starch, stains or repairs. 5) Pull open the Drop Off door and place the bag inside.
kiosk.appliesTo: Shaker Heights, Highland Heights, Solon, Parma, Broadview Heights
kiosk.action: Answer one step at a time

kiosk.question: Where do I get a bag?
kiosk.answer: The numbered bags are under the drop-off kiosk.
kiosk.appliesTo: Shaker Heights, Highland Heights, Solon, Parma, Broadview Heights

kiosk.question: How do I leave instructions (starch, stains, repairs)?
kiosk.answer: You can leave notes as part of your drop-off at the kiosk.
kiosk.appliesTo: Shaker Heights, Highland Heights, Solon, Parma, Broadview Heights

kiosk.question: What can I put in the kiosk?
kiosk.answer: Everything except rugs and wedding gowns. Comforters, leather and alterations can all go in the kiosk.
kiosk.appliesTo: Shaker Heights, Highland Heights, Solon, Parma, Broadview Heights

kiosk.question: Can I drop off a rug at the kiosk?
kiosk.answer: No, rugs can't be dropped at the kiosk. I can connect you with our staff to set that up.
kiosk.appliesTo: Shaker Heights, Highland Heights, Solon, Parma, Broadview Heights
kiosk.action: Transfer to staff (7:00 AM–9:00 PM); otherwise take a message

kiosk.question: Can I drop off a wedding gown at the kiosk?
kiosk.answer: No. Please bring wedding gowns to a staffed location during staffed hours: Highland Heights (Mon–Sat 10:30am–7pm; Sun 12pm–7pm), Solon (Mon–Fri 9am–12pm), Parma (Mon–Fri 10am–12pm), Broadview Heights (Mon–Fri 8am–5pm; Sat 8am–2pm) or Warren (Mon–Fri 8am–6pm; Sat 9am–3pm).
kiosk.appliesTo: Rite stores

kiosk.question: When does my ready date start counting if I drop off overnight?
kiosk.answer: Your ready date follows the normal schedule for the day and time you drop off.
kiosk.appliesTo: Shaker Heights, Highland Heights, Solon, Parma, Broadview Heights
kiosk.action: Answer: look up the Turnaround tab

kiosk.question: How will I know my order is ready?
kiosk.answer: You'll get a text and an email when your order is ready.
kiosk.appliesTo: Shaker Heights, Highland Heights, Solon, Parma, Broadview Heights

kiosk.question: How do I pick up my order from the kiosk?
kiosk.answer: 1) On the kiosk screen, tap Existing Customer and enter your phone number. 2) Tap Pick Up Clothes. 3) If you have a balance, tap or insert your card to pay. 4) The kiosk retrieves your clothes and brings them out at the Pick Up side.
kiosk.appliesTo: Shaker Heights, Highland Heights, Solon, Parma, Broadview Heights
kiosk.action: Answer one step at a time

kiosk.question: How long will my order stay in the kiosk?
kiosk.answer: There's no set time limit. Your order stays in the kiosk until you pick it up.
kiosk.appliesTo: Shaker Heights, Highland Heights, Solon, Parma, Broadview Heights

kiosk.question: How do I pay when I use the kiosk?
kiosk.answer: If you have a card on file, it's charged automatically. If not, the kiosk shows any unpaid orders and the total at pickup, and you tap or insert your credit or debit card to pay.
kiosk.appliesTo: Shaker Heights, Highland Heights, Solon, Parma, Broadview Heights

kiosk.question: Can I keep a card on file?
kiosk.answer: Yes. With a card on file, your orders are charged automatically, so you don't have to pay at the kiosk.
kiosk.appliesTo: Shaker Heights, Highland Heights, Solon, Parma, Broadview Heights

kiosk.question: The kiosk screen is frozen or isn't working.
kiosk.answer: I'm sorry about that. Our staff is automatically alerted when the kiosk has a problem, and they'll send someone to fix it. Let me connect you with a staff member.
kiosk.appliesTo: Shaker Heights, Highland Heights, Solon, Parma, Broadview Heights
kiosk.action: Transfer to staff (7:00 AM–9:00 PM); otherwise take a message

kiosk.question: The door didn't open / my order isn't there.
kiosk.answer: I'm sorry about that. Our staff is automatically alerted when the kiosk has a problem, and they'll send someone to fix it. Let me connect you with a staff member.
kiosk.appliesTo: Shaker Heights, Highland Heights, Solon, Parma, Broadview Heights
kiosk.action: Transfer to staff (7:00 AM–9:00 PM); otherwise take a message

kiosk.question: I put something in by mistake. Can I get it back?
kiosk.answer: Let me connect you with a staff member who can help with that.
kiosk.appliesTo: Shaker Heights, Highland Heights, Solon, Parma, Broadview Heights
kiosk.action: Transfer to staff (7:00 AM–9:00 PM); otherwise take a message

kiosk.question: Is there a video showing how the kiosk works?
kiosk.answer: Yes. Rite has a video that shows how the kiosk works. Visit rite-drycleaners.com for more information.
kiosk.appliesTo: Shaker Heights, Highland Heights, Solon, Parma, Broadview Heights
